## Rules

- Follow §4 exactly. Clients read committed snapshots before calls, treat cursor as opaque, use one idempotency key for the replay pair and compare semantic results/errors. No source/autoload access and no assumptions outside published protocol.

## Guidance

Use stdlib clients and a local test server. Normalize only fields declared non-semantic by the snapshot; do not mask status/code/body differences. Tamper a copied snapshot, never the canonical file.

## Required Reads

1) `@plan/phases/P17/phase.json`; 2) `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json` §0, §4; 3) `@plan/phases/P17/P17.1.json`; 4) `@plan/phases/P13/P13.12.json`; 5) `@plan/knowledge/research-P13-design.json` §2, §5, §9; 6) `@plan/decisions/D66.json`; 7) `@plan/decisions/D72.json`; 8) `@plan/phases/P13/P13.10.json`; 9) `@plan/decisions/D105.json`; 10) `@plan/decisions/D106.json`.

## Implementation Rules

Follow §4 exactly. Clients read committed snapshots before calls, treat cursor as opaque, use one idempotency key for the replay pair and compare semantic results/errors. No source/autoload access and no assumptions outside published protocol.

## Code Guidance

Use stdlib clients and a local test server. Normalize only fields declared non-semantic by the snapshot; do not mask status/code/body differences. Tamper a copied snapshot, never the canonical file.

## Validation

Query, command, idempotent replay, cursor continuation and both error media types pass via REST; matching exposed operation passes via MCP; parity receipt binds snapshot digests. HTTP success→record/field revocation→MCP replay denies/prunes with one effect. UUIDv7, UUID, ULID and integer ResourceIds round-trip through both clients. Stale digest, unexpected field and GraphQL artifact fail.

## Deliverables

Two external client fixtures and digest-bound REST/MCP parity evidence.
